examples.chinese: 這種飲料很好喝。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng yǐnliào hěn hǎohē.
examples.english: This kind of beverage tastes good.

examples.chinese: 我想喝一點兒飲料。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ xiǎng hē yìdiǎnr yǐnliào.
examples.english: I would like to have a little drink.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: Does this restaurant sell beverage?

examples.chinese: 天氣太熱，我要喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì tài rè, wǒ yào hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: The weather is too hot, I want some beverage.

examples.chinese: 他們賣很多種飲料。
examples.pinyin: Tāmen mài hěn duō zhǒng yǐnliào.
examples.english: They have various kinds of drink.

examples.chinese: 天氣好熱，我們去喝飲料，好不好？
examples.pinyin: Tiānqì hǎo rè, wǒmen qù hē yǐnliào, hǎo bù hǎo?
examples.english: The weather is so hot. How about we go have some drink?

examples.chinese: 太好了！我最愛吃牛肉麵。他們也賣飲料嗎？
examples.pinyin: Tài hǎo le! Wǒ zuì ài chī niúròu miàn. Tāmen yě mài yǐnliào ma?
examples.english: That is awesome! Beef noodles is my favorite. Do they sell drinks as well?

examples.chinese: 你很渴嗎？我有一瓶飲料，你要不要喝？
examples.pinyin: Nǐ hěn kě ma? Wǒ yǒu yì píng yǐnliào, nǐ yào bú yào hē?
examples.english: Are you thirsty? I have a bottle of beverage, would you like to have some?

examples.chinese: 台灣夏天的天氣很熱，很多人都喜歡喝飲料。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān xiàtiān de tiānqì hěn rè, hěn duō rén dōu xǐhuān hē yǐnliào.
examples.english: During summer the weather is very hot in Taiwan, many people like to have beverages.

examples.chinese: 那家飲料店的飲料很好喝，我們去那裡買。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā yǐnliào diàn de yǐnliào hěn hǎohē, wǒmen qù nàlǐ mǎi.
examples.english: That beverage store serves great beverages. Let’s go there and get some.

examples.chinese: 學校附近有很多飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào fùjìn yǒu hěn duō yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: There are many beverage shops near the school.

examples.chinese: 我只想喝茶，別的飲料我都不想喝。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ xiǎng hē chá, bié de yǐnliào wǒ dōu bù xiǎng hē.
examples.english: I only want to drink tea; I don't want to drink any other beverages.

examples.chinese: 媽媽告訴我，不要忘記去超級市場買飲料。
examples.pinyin: Māma gàosu wǒ, bùyào wàngjì qù chāojí shìchǎng mǎi yǐnliào.
examples.english: Mom told me not to forget to go to the supermarket to buy drinks.

examples.chinese: 我們公司附近有很多餐廳和飲料店。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen gōngsī fùjìn yǒu hěn duō cāntīng hé yǐnliào diàn.
examples.english: Near our company there are many restaurants and beverage shops.

examples.chinese: 這是博物館的網址，你可以先看看。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shì bówùguǎn de wǎngzhǐ, nǐ kěyǐ xiān kànkan.
examples.english: This is the museum's web address; you can take a look first.

examples.chinese: 他跑得很快，如果跟他比賽，我沒有機會贏，一定會輸。
examples.pinyin: Tā pǎo de hěn kuài, rúguǒ gēn tā bǐsài, wǒ méiyǒu jīhuì yíng, yīdìng huì shū.
examples.english: He runs very fast; if I compete with him, I have no chance of winning—I will definitely lose.

examples.chinese: 小畢本來認為自己的書法寫得很好，但是上次比賽輸了以後，他就失去自信了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Bì běnlái rènwéi zìjǐ de shūfǎ xiě de hěn hǎo, dànshì shàng cì bǐsài shū le yǐhòu, tā jiù shīqù zìxìn le.
examples.english: Xiǎo Bì originally thought his calligraphy was very good, but after losing the last competition, he lost his self-confidence.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 這場棒球比賽已打到最後一局，可是仍無法看出誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Zhè chǎng bàngqiú bǐsài yǐ dǎ dào zuìhòu yì jú, kěshì réng wúfǎ kànchū shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: This baseball game has already reached the final inning, but it is still impossible to tell who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 你不要忘了告訴他明天有考試。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ búyào wàng le gàosu tā míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì.
examples.english: Don't forget to tell him that there is an exam tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 考試開始以後，我們不可以跟同學說話。
examples.pinyin: Kǎoshì kāishǐ yǐhòu, wǒmen bù kěyǐ gēn tóngxué shuōhuà.
examples.english: After the exam starts, we cannot talk with classmates.

examples.chinese: 我只記得明天有考試，不記得有功課。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ jìde míngtiān yǒu kǎoshì, bù jìde yǒu gōngkè.
examples.english: I only remember that there is an exam tomorrow; I don't remember that there is homework.

examples.chinese: 明天要考試，每個學生都很緊張。今天的考試不難，大家都考得不錯。
examples.pinyin: Míngtiān yào kǎoshì, měi ge xuésheng dōu hěn jǐnzhāng. Jīntiān de kǎoshì bù nán, dàjiā dōu kǎo de búcuò.
examples.english: There will be an exam tomorrow, so every student is very nervous. Today's exam was not difficult; everyone did pretty well on the test.

examples.chinese: 下個星期華語課有期中考，我有一點兒緊張，所以每天晚上都讀書，也練習寫字，希望下個星期的考試能考得很好。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqí Huáyǔ kè yǒu qízhōngkǎo, wǒ yǒu yìdiǎnr jǐnzhāng, suǒyǐ měi tiān wǎnshang dōu dúshū, yě liànxí xiězì, xīwàng xià ge xīngqí de kǎoshì néng kǎo de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: I will have the midterm exam for Chinese class next week. I am a bit nervous so I study every night and practice writing Chinese characters as well. I hope I can do well on the exam next week.

examples.chinese: 那個演員非常喜歡演戲，不管導演給他多麼難演的角色，他都願意試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nàge yǎnyuán fēicháng xǐhuan yǎnxì, bùguǎn dǎoyǎn gěi tā duōme nán yǎn de juésè, tā dōu yuànyì shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That actor really loves acting; no matter how difficult a role the director gives him, he is willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 這家餐廳最辣的牛肉麵， 小程挑戰過好幾次，可惜都沒吃完。寫劇本對我來說是個很大的挑戰，但是也能得到不少收穫，所以我願意試試。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā cāntīng zuì là de niúròumiàn, Xiǎo Chéng tiǎozhàn guò hǎo jǐ cì, kěxī dōu méi chī wán. Xiě jùběn duì wǒ lái shuō shì ge hěn dà de tiǎozhàn, dànshì yě néng dédào bùshǎo shōuhuò, suǒyǐ wǒ yuànyì shìshi.
examples.english: Xiao Cheng has challenged the spiciest beef noodles at this restaurant several times, but unfortunately he never finished them. Writing scripts is a big challenge for me, but I can also gain a lot from it, so I am willing to give it a try.

examples.chinese: 今天中文口試時我太緊張了，一時不知道怎麼回答，所以成績不太好。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān Zhōngwén kǒushì shí wǒ tài jǐnzhāng le, yīshí bù zhīdào zěnme huídá, suǒyǐ chéngjī bù tài hǎo.
examples.english: During the Chinese oral exam today, I was too nervous and for a moment didn't know how to answer, so my grade wasn't very good.

examples.chinese: 那家廣告公司提供了五個工作機會，只要是設計系畢業的都可以去試試看。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā guǎnggào gōngsī tígōng le wǔ ge gōngzuò jīhuì, zhǐyào shì shèjì xì bìyè de dōu kěyǐ qù shìshi kàn.
examples.english: That advertising company provided five job opportunities; anyone who has graduated from a design department can go and give it a try.

examples.chinese: 那家店正在推銷巧克力口味的小籠包，我們要不要去嘗試一下？
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā diàn zhèngzài tuīxiāo qiǎokèlì kǒuwèi de xiǎolóngbāo, wǒmen yào bù yào qù chángshì yīxià?
examples.english: That shop is promoting chocolate-flavored soup dumplings; shall we go try them?

examples.chinese: 我和朋友昨天去河邊露營， 我們試著在河裡抓魚，沒想到真的抓到了五條魚。金先生親眼見過警察在街上抓小偷，一個跑來跑去，一個追來追去，他覺得太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ hé péngyǒu zuótiān qù hébiān lùyíng, wǒmen shìzhe zài hé lǐ zhuā yú, méi xiǎngdào zhēn de zhuā dào le wǔ tiáo yú. Jīn xiānsheng qīnyǎn jiàn guò jǐngchá zài jiē shàng zhuā xiǎotōu, yī ge pǎo lái pǎo qù, yī ge zhuī lái zhuī qù, tā juéde tài cìjī le.
examples.english: My friend and I went camping by the river yesterday; we tried to catch fish in the river, and unexpectedly, we really caught five fish. Mr. Jin has seen with his own eyes the police catching a thief on the street—one running back and forth, the other chasing back and forth—he thought it was too exciting.

examples.chinese: 今天的數學考試我只考了三十分，要是被爸爸知道，他一定會罵我的。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de shùxué kǎoshì wǒ zhǐ kǎo le sānshí fēn, yàoshi bèi bàba zhīdào, tā yídìng huì mà wǒ de.
examples.english: I only scored 30 on today’s math test; if my dad finds out, he will definitely scold me.

examples.chinese: 我的漢字考試總是不及格，經過三個月努力地練習，終於及格了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de Hànzì kǎoshì zǒngshì bù jígé, jīngguò sān ge yuè nǔlì de liànxí, zhōngyú jígé le.
examples.english: I always fail my Chinese character exams; after three months of hard practice, I finally passed.

examples.chinese: 老師說這次口試的題目不難，回答是只要放輕鬆、別緊張，就沒問題了。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī shuō zhè cì kǒushì de tímù bù nán, huídá shì zhǐyào fàng qīngsōng, bié jǐnzhāng, jiù méi wèntí le.
examples.english: The teacher said the questions on this oral exam are not hard; the answer is that as long as you relax and don't be nervous, there's no problem.

examples.chinese: 這次數學考試的題目似乎難了點，因為超過三分之二的學生考不及格。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shùxué kǎoshì de tímù sìhū nán le diǎn, yīnwèi chāoguò sān fēn zhī èr de xuéshēng kǎo bù jígé.
examples.english: The questions on this math exam seem a bit difficult, because more than two-thirds of the students failed.

examples.chinese: 張太太一個人管三個孩子，家裡大大小小的事情也是她負責的，太辛苦了。姊姊：下個星期就要大學考試了，你怎麼不用功念書，反而天天出去玩？ 弟弟：妳別管我，這是我自己的事。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng tàitai yī gè rén guǎn sān gè háizi, jiālǐ dàdàxiǎoxiǎo de shìqíng yě shì tā fùzé de, tài xīngkǔ le. Jiějie: Xià gè xīngqī jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, nǐ zěnme bù yònggōng niànshū, fǎn'ér tiāntiān chūqù wán? Dìdi: Nǐ bié guǎn wǒ, zhè shì wǒ zìjǐ de shì.
examples.english: Mrs. Zhang manages three children all by herself, and she is also responsible for all the big and small matters at home; it's too hard. Older sister: The university exam is next week; why aren't you studying hard, but instead going out to play every day? Younger brother: Don't manage me; this is my own business.

examples.chinese: 弟弟因為明天要去大學面試，緊張得整個晚上都睡不好。為了準備這次的面試，我看了很多相關資料，還不斷地練習面試時跟主管的對話。
examples.pinyin: Dìdi yīnwèi míngtiān yào qù dàxué miànshì, jǐnzhāng de zhěnggè wǎnshang dōu shuì bù hǎo. Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì de miànshì, wǒ kàn le hěnduō xiāngguān zīliào, hái búduàn de liànxí miànshì shí gēn zhǔguǎn de duìhuà.
examples.english: Because my younger brother is going to a university interview tomorrow, he was so nervous that he couldn't sleep well the whole night. In order to prepare for this interview, I read a lot of related information and also constantly practiced the conversation with the manager during the interview.

examples.chinese: A:您好，歡迎您來面試。請問貴姓？ B:您好，我姓童，很高興今天能到貴公司來面試。
examples.pinyin: A: Nín hǎo, huānyíng nín lái miànshì. Qǐngwèn guì xìng? B: Nín hǎo, wǒ xìng Tóng, hěn gāoxìng jīntiān néng dào guì gōngsī lái miànshì.
examples.english: A: Hello, welcome to the interview. May I ask your honorable surname? B: Hello, my surname is Tong. I'm very happy to be able to come to your honorable company for an interview today.

examples.chinese: 方老師非常有耐心，就算學生考試的成績很糟，也從來沒發過脾氣。
examples.pinyin: Fāng lǎoshī fēicháng yǒu nàixīn, jiùsuàn xuéshēng kǎoshì de chéngjī hěn zāo, yě cónglái méi fā guo píqì.
examples.english: Teacher Fang is very patient; even if the students' exam scores are very bad, she has never lost her temper.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 小明順利通過了大學考試，今年就是一年級的新生了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎomíng shùnlì tōngguò le dàxué kǎoshì, jīnnián jiù shì yī niánjí de xīnshēng le.
examples.english: Xiaoming successfully passed the university exam; this year he is a freshman.

examples.chinese: 這次世界運動會的一百公尺賽跑，美國運動員跑出了九點三七秒的新記錄。老師把學生每次考試的分數記錄下來，這樣就能知道學生是不是進步了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì shìjiè yùndònghuì de yībǎi gōngchǐ sàipǎo, Měiguó yùndòngyuán pǎochū le jiǔ diǎn sān qī miǎo de xīn jìlù. Lǎoshī bǎ xuéshēng měi cì kǎoshì de fēnshù jìlù xiàlái, zhèyàng jiù néng zhīdào xuéshēng shì bù shì jìnbù le.
examples.english: In this World Games 100-meter race, the American athlete set a new record of 9.37 seconds. The teacher records the students' scores for each exam, so that it can be known whether the students have improved.

examples.chinese: 一般來說，面試時要準備的相關文件包括個人基本資料、畢業證書等等。
examples.pinyin: Yībān lái shuō, miànshì shí yào zhǔnbèi de xiāngguān wénjiàn bāokuò gèrén jīběn zīliào, bìyè zhèngshū děngděng.
examples.english: Generally speaking, the relevant documents to prepare for an interview include basic personal information, graduation certificate, and so on.

examples.chinese: 面試時必須穿正式的服裝，跟老闆對話時，也應表現出客氣、 謙虛的態度。
examples.pinyin: Miànshì shí bìxū chuān zhèngshì de fúzhuāng, gēn lǎobǎn duìhuà shí, yě yīng biǎoxiàn chū kèqì, qiānxū de tàidù.
examples.english: During an interview, you must wear formal clothing; when speaking with the boss, you should also show a polite and modest attitude.

examples.chinese: 站在老闆背後的那個人已經通過了面試，明天就要來上班了。「每個成功男人的背後，都有一個偉大的女人。」你覺得這句話有道理嗎？
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhàn zài lǎobǎn bèihòu de nàge rén yǐjīng tōngguò le miànshì, míngtiān jiù yào lái shàngbān le. 2. Měi ge chénggōng nánrén de bèihòu, dōu yǒu yí ge wěidà de nǚrén. Nǐ juéde zhè jù huà yǒu dàolǐ ma?
examples.english: 1. The person standing behind the boss has already passed the interview and will come to work tomorrow. 2. Behind every successful man, there is a great woman. Do you think this saying makes sense?

examples.chinese: 如想通過那家企業的面試，就得先熟悉他們的產品特色與銷售方式。
examples.pinyin: Rú xiǎng tōngguò nà jiā qǐyè de miànshì, jiù děi xiān shúxī tāmen de chǎnpǐn tèsè yǔ xiāoshòu fāngshì.
examples.english: If you want to pass that company's interview, you must first be familiar with their product features and sales methods.

examples.chinese: 這課的漢字我都認得，但還不太會寫，所以筆試時好些字都寫錯了。弟弟：爺爺怎麼常把我和你的名字搞錯？ 哥哥：爺爺年紀太大了，腦子不清楚，好像不認得我們了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè kè de Hànzì wǒ dōu rènde, dàn hái bù tài huì xiě, suǒyǐ bǐshì shí hǎoxiē zì dōu xiě cuò le. Dìdi: Yéye zěnme cháng bǎ wǒ hé nǐ de míngzi gǎo cuò? Gēge: Yéye niánjì tài dà le, nǎozi bù qīngchu, hǎoxiàng bù rènde wǒmen le.
examples.english: I can recognize all the Chinese characters in this lesson, but I am not yet able to write them well, so I wrote many characters incorrectly on the written test. Younger brother: Why does Grandpa often mix up your name and mine? Older brother: Grandpa is too old and his mind is unclear; it seems he no longer recognizes us.

examples.chinese: 今天客人跟著小溫去參觀工廠，也試用了新產品，一切安排都令他十分滿意。
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān kèrén gēnzhe Xiǎo Wēn qù cānguān gōngchǎng, yě shìyòng le xīn chǎnpǐn, yīqiè ānpái dōu lìng tā shífēn mǎnyì.
examples.english: Today the guests followed Xiao Wen to visit the factory and also tried out new products; all the arrangements made him very satisfied.

examples.chinese: 這次考試的分數沒有我想的那麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì kǎoshì de fēnshù méiyǒu wǒ xiǎng de nàme chà.
examples.english: The score on this exam is not as bad as I thought.

examples.chinese: 我跟室友的個性、興趣都差不多，所以我們是好朋友。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn shìyǒu de gèxìng, xìngqù dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ wǒmen shì hǎo péngyou.
examples.english: My roommate and I are similar in personality and interests, so we are good friends.

examples.chinese: 林小姐弄錯了約會的時間，所以遲到了半個小時。我覺得「害怕」跟「可怕」的意思差不多，所以常弄錯。
examples.pinyin: Lín xiǎojiě nòngcuò le yuēhuì de shíjiān, suǒyǐ chídào le bàn ge xiǎoshí. Wǒ juéde “hàipà” gēn “kěpà” de yìsi chàbuduō, suǒyǐ cháng nòngcuò.
examples.english: Miss Lin made a mistake about the appointment time, so she was half an hour late. I think “afraid” and “scary” have similar meanings, so I often misunderstand.

examples.chinese: 我的房租每個月一萬塊，加上水費、電費，差不多一萬三。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de fángzū měi gè yuè yī wàn kuài, jiāshàng shuǐfèi, diànfèi, chàbuduō yī wàn sān.
examples.english: My rent is 10,000 dollars a month; plus water and electricity fees, it's about 13,000.

examples.chinese: 他喜歡玩手機遊戲，差不多每天玩兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Tā xǐhuan wán shǒujī yóuxì, chàbuduō měitiān wán liǎng ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: He likes to play mobile games, and plays for about two hours almost every day.

examples.chinese: 從中部坐車到南部去，差不多要兩個小時。
examples.pinyin: Cóng zhōngbù zuò chē dào nánbù qù, chàbuduō yào liǎng gè xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Taking a bus from the central part to the southern part takes about two hours.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸是老師，他很喜歡他的工作。他在餐廳工作，每天差不多都晚上十點回家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba shì lǎoshī, tā hěn xǐhuān tā de gōngzuò. Tā zài cāntīng gōngzuò, měitiān chàbuduō dōu wǎnshàng shí diǎn huí jiā.
examples.english: My dad is a teacher; he really likes his job. He works at a restaurant, and he almost always gets home around ten at night every day.

examples.chinese: A:你每天幾點起床？ B:差不多七點。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ měi tiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng? B: Chàbuduō qī diǎn.
examples.english: A: What time do you get up every day? B: About seven o'clock.

examples.chinese: 美國的一毛錢差不多是台灣的三塊錢。
examples.pinyin: Měiguó de yī máo qián chàbuduō shì Táiwān de sān kuài qián.
examples.english: One dime in the US is about three dollars in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 今天的考試，姐姐差兩分就一百了，真可惜！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān de kǎoshì, jiějie chà liǎng fēn jiù yībǎi le, zhēn kěxī!
examples.english: On today's exam, my older sister was short of two points to reach 100—what a pity!

examples.chinese: 我大哥今年三十歲了，我們的年紀差了十歲。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dàgē jīnnián sānshí suì le, wǒmen de niánjì chà le shí suì.
examples.english: My oldest brother is thirty years old this year; there is a ten-year age difference between us.

examples.chinese: 請你說明一下，這些產品的功能有什麼差別？
examples.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ shuōmíng yíxià, zhèxiē chǎnpǐn de gōngnéng yǒu shénme chābié?
examples.english: Please explain, what differences are there in the functions of these products?

examples.chinese: 他這次到美國去出差，幫公司處理了不少問題。
examples.pinyin: Tā zhè cì dào Měiguó qù chūchāi, bāng gōngsī chǔlǐ le bù shǎo wèntí.
examples.english: He went on a business trip to the US this time and handled quite a few problems for the company.

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點兒就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎnr jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—so forgetful!

examples.chinese: 他上禮拜去買電腦，差點就忘了自己的手機，真糊塗！
examples.pinyin: Tā shàng lǐbài qù mǎi diànnǎo, chàdiǎn jiù wàng le zìjǐ de shǒujī, zhēn hútú!
examples.english: Last week he went to buy a computer and almost forgot his own cell phone—really silly!

examples.chinese: 台灣的夏天，差不多五點鐘天就亮了。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de xiàtiān, chàbuduō wǔ diǎn zhōng tiān jiù liàng le.
examples.english: In summer in Taiwan, the sky is bright at about five o'clock.

examples.chinese: 去年台灣冬天的溫度很低，差不多五度，冷得不得了。
examples.pinyin: Qùnián Táiwān dōngtiān de wēndù hěn dī, chàbuduō wǔ dù, lěng de bùdéliǎo.
examples.english: Last year, the temperature in Taiwan in winter was very low, about five degrees, and it was extremely cold.

examples.chinese: 下個星期我要和經理一起到美國去出差。
examples.pinyin: Xià ge xīngqī wǒ yào hé jīnglǐ yìqǐ dào Měiguó qù chūchāi.
examples.english: Next week I will go to the US on a business trip together with the manager.

examples.chinese: 我們的成長經驗、教育背景都差不多，所以想法也很像。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de chéngzhǎng jīngyàn, jiàoyù bèijǐng dōu chàbuduō, suǒyǐ xiǎngfǎ yě hěn xiàng.
examples.english: Our upbringing experiences and educational backgrounds are about the same, so our ideas are also very similar.

examples.chinese: 我室友的生活習慣很差，我已經忍耐他很久了，真希望他馬上搬走。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shìyǒu de shēnghuó xíguàn hěn chà, wǒ yǐjīng rěnnài tā hěn jiǔ le, zhēn xīwàng tā mǎshàng bān zǒu.
examples.english: My roommate's living habits are very bad; I have tolerated him for a long time, and I really hope he moves out immediately.

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: 這家專櫃的店員比剛才那家的還要兇，難怪生意這麼差。
examples.pinyin: Zhè jiā zhuānguì de diànyuán bǐ gāngcái nà jiā de hái yào xiōng, nánguài shēngyì zhème chà.
examples.english: The clerk at this brand counter is even fiercer than the one at the previous store; no wonder business is so bad.

examples.chinese: 這兩部筆電的功能差異不大，就是價錢差了幾百塊。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng bù bǐdiàn de gōngnéng chāyì bú dà, jiùshì jiàqián chà le jǐ bǎi kuài.
examples.english: The functional difference between these two laptops is not big; it's just that the price differs by a few hundred dollars.

examples.chinese: 那位老先生走著走著，路旁的樹木突然倒了下來，他差一點就受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi lǎo xiānshēng zǒuzhe zǒuzhe, lù páng de shùmù tūrán dǎo le xiàlái, tā chà yīdiǎn jiù shòushāng le.
examples.english: That elderly gentleman was walking and walking, when suddenly the trees beside the road fell down; he was almost injured.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 東西方的文化差異很大，像穿著、音樂、哲學等風格都不相同。
examples.pinyin: Dōngxīfāng de wénhuà chāyì hěn dà, xiàng chuānzhuó, yīnyuè, zhéxué děng fēnggé dōu bù xiāngtóng.
examples.english: The cultural differences between East and West are great; styles such as apparel, music, and philosophy are all different.

examples.chinese: 他做事的態度很差，而且一不高興就罵人，誰受得了這種人啊！
examples.pinyin: Tā zuòshì de tàidù hěn chà, érqiě yí bù gāoxìng jiù mà rén, shéi shòu de liǎo zhè zhǒng rén a!
examples.english: His attitude toward work is very bad, and whenever he is unhappy he scolds people; who can tolerate this kind of person!

examples.chinese: 王老闆老是要求員工隨時配合他開會、加班、出差，真教人受不了。
examples.pinyin: Wáng lǎobǎn lǎoshì yāoqiú yuángōng suíshí pèihé tā kāihuì, jiābān, chūchāi, zhēn jiào rén shòu bù liǎo.
examples.english: Boss Wang is always requiring his employees to cooperate with him at any time for meetings, overtime, and business trips; it really makes people unable to stand it.

examples.chinese: 簡老闆因為生意的關係，經常接觸越南人，相當了解兩國之間工作習慣的差異。
examples.pinyin: Jiǎn lǎobǎn yīnwèi shēngyì de guānxì, jīngcháng jiēchù Yuènánrén, xiāngdāng liǎojiě liǎng guó zhījiān gōngzuò xíguàn de chāyì.
examples.english: Boss Jian, because of business, frequently contacts Vietnamese people and quite understands the differences in working habits between the two countries.

examples.chinese: 不少人批評那家健身中心教練的教學品質很差，以後絕對不會再去了。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo rén pīpíng nà jiā jiànshēn zhōngxīn jiàoliàn de jiàoxué pǐnzhí hěn chà, yǐhòu juéduì bú huì zài qù le.
examples.english: Many people criticize that fitness center's coaches' teaching quality as very poor; they will absolutely not go there again.

examples.chinese: 我父親是個警察，只要他負責的小組有重要任務時，就得出差一兩個星期。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ fùqīn shì ge jǐngchá, zhǐyào tā fùzé de xiǎozǔ yǒu zhòngyào rènwu shí, jiù děi chūchāi yī liǎng ge xīngqī.
examples.english: My father is a police officer; whenever the team he is responsible for has an important task, he has to go on a business trip for one or two weeks.

examples.chinese: 聽說天上的一天，差不多是人間的好幾十年。這裡的風景美極了，好像人間天堂一樣。
examples.pinyin: 1. Tīngshuō tiānshàng de yì tiān, chàbuduō shì rénjiān de hǎo jǐ shí nián. 2. Zhèlǐ de fēngjǐng měi jí le, hǎoxiàng rénjiān tiāntáng yíyàng.
examples.english: 1. I've heard that one day in heaven is about several decades in the human world. 2. The scenery here is extremely beautiful, as if it were a paradise on earth.

examples.chinese: 臺灣的芒果冰好吃得沒話說，連吃過的外國人也十分滿意。A:今年銷售商品的成績比以往差， 大家都說是你的責任。 B:你是我最好的朋友，連你也這麼認為，我就沒話說了。
examples.pinyin: 1. Táiwān de mángguǒ bīng hǎochī de méi huà shuō, lián chī guò de wàiguórén yě shífēn mǎnyì. 2. A: Jīnnián xiāoshòu shāngpǐn de chéngjì bǐ yǐwǎng chà, dàjiā dōu shuō shì nǐ de zérèn. B: Nǐ shì wǒ zuì hǎo de péngyǒu, lián nǐ yě zhème rènwéi, wǒ jiù méi huà shuō le.
examples.english: 1. Taiwan's mango shaved ice is delicious beyond words; even foreigners who have tried it are extremely satisfied. 2. A: This year's product sales performance is worse than before; everyone says it's your responsibility. B: You are my best friend, and even you think so—then I have nothing to say.

examples.chinese: 由於雲端科技的進步，人類的生活方式跟以往比起來有很大的差異。
examples.pinyin: Yóuyú yúnduān kējì de jìnbù, rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì gēn yǐwǎng bǐ qǐlái yǒu hěn dà de chāyì.
examples.english: Owing to advances in cloud technology, humans' way of life has great differences compared to the past.

examples.chinese: 中國南北方的飲食習慣有一些差異，南方人多吃米飯，北方人多吃餃子、饅頭等麵食。
examples.pinyin: Zhōngguó nánběifāng de yǐnshí xíguàn yǒu yīxiē chāyì, nánfāng rén duō chī mǐfàn, běifāng rén duō chī jiǎozi, mántou děng miànshí.
examples.english: There are some differences in eating habits between northern and southern China: southerners eat more cooked rice, while northerners eat more dumplings, steamed buns, and other wheat-based foods.

examples.chinese: 我玩了整晚的手機遊戲，結果第二天差點被爸爸打一頓。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ wán le zhěng wǎn de shǒujī yóuxì, jiéguǒ dì-èr tiān chàdiǎn bèi bàba dǎ yī dùn.
examples.english: I played mobile games all night, and as a result, the next day I almost got a beating from my dad.

examples.chinese: 有一些口罩正面跟反面的差異很小，不過一般來說，正面的顏色較深，反面的顏色較淺。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yīxiē kǒuzhào zhèngmiàn gēn fǎnmiàn de chāyì hěn xiǎo, bùguò yībān lái shuō, zhèngmiàn de yánsè jiào shēn, fǎnmiàn de yánsè jiào qiǎn.
examples.english: For some masks, the difference between the front side and the reverse side is very small, but generally speaking, the front side is darker in color and the reverse side is lighter.

examples.chinese: 那家商店的廣告牌子被一陣強風吹起後，還差一點打到路上的摩托車，真可怕。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā shāngdiàn de guǎnggào páizi bèi yī zhèn qiángfēng chuī qǐ hòu, hái chà yīdiǎn dǎ dào lùshàng de mótuōchē, zhēn kěpà.
examples.english: After that shop's advertising sign was blown up by a gust of strong wind, it almost hit a motorcycle on the road; it was really scary.

examples.chinese: 根據目前科學研究的資料，女性與男性在能力、態度和行為等方面的差異都非常小。
examples.pinyin: Gēnjù mùqián kēxué yánjiū de zīliào, nǚxìng yǔ nánxìng zài nénglì, tàidù hé xíngwéi děng fāngmiàn de chāyì dōu fēicháng xiǎo.
examples.english: According to current scientific research data, the differences between women and men in aspects such as ability, attitude, and behavior are all very small.

examples.chinese: 這位郵差的聲音很大，每次他來送信，整條街全都聽見了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè wèi yóuchāi de shēngyīn hěn dà, měi cì tā lái sòng xìn, zhěng tiáo jiē quán dōu tīngjiàn le.
examples.english: This postman's voice is very loud; every time he comes to deliver mail, the whole street hears it.

examples.chinese: 這兩臺機器樣子相同，但在構造與功能上是有差別的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè liǎng tái jīqì yàngzi xiāngtóng, dàn zài gòuzào yǔ gōngnéng shàng shì yǒu chābié de.
examples.english: These two machines look the same, but they differ in structure and function.

examples.chinese: 無論做錯事或出差錯，任何人都應主動負起責任。
examples.pinyin: Wúlùn zuòcuò shì huò chū chācuò, rènhé rén dōu yīng zhǔdòng fùqǐ zérèn.
examples.english: Whether you do something wrong or a mistake occurs, anyone should take responsibility proactively.

examples.chinese: 腦部血管很複雜，做腦部手術時不能有任何的差錯。
examples.pinyin: Nǎobù xuèguǎn hěn fùzá, zuò nǎobù shǒushù shí bùnéng yǒu rènhé de chācuò.
examples.english: The blood vessels in the brain are very complex; when performing brain surgery, there must not be any mistake.

examples.chinese: 這次會議的效率真差，有人竟然沒看資料就來了，真是誇張。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì huìyì de xiàolǜ zhēn chà, yǒu rén jìngrán méi kàn zīliào jiù lái le, zhēn shì kuāzhāng.
examples.english: The efficiency of this meeting is really poor; someone surprisingly came without even looking at the materials—that's really outrageous.

examples.chinese: 當室內與戶外溫度的差別很大時，我就容易感冒。
examples.pinyin: Dāng shìnèi yǔ hùwài wēndù de chābié hěn dà shí, wǒ jiù róngyì gǎnmào.
examples.english: When the difference between indoor and outdoor temperatures is large, I easily catch a cold.

examples.chinese: 他透過古典文學來討論古代與現代的文化差異。
examples.pinyin: Tā tòuguò gǔdiǎn wénxué lái tǎolùn gǔdài yǔ xiàndài de wénhuà chāyì.
examples.english: He discusses the cultural differences between ancient and modern times through classical literature.

examples.chinese: 她的外語能力不錯，因此公司經常派她到國外出差。
examples.pinyin: Tā de wàiyǔ nénglì bùcuò, yīncǐ gōngsī jīngcháng pài tā dào guówài chūchāi.
examples.english: Her foreign language ability is good, so the company often sends her abroad on business trips.

examples.chinese: 解決種族之間因文化差異產生的問題，最好的辦法就是互相尊重。
examples.pinyin: Jiějué zhǒngzú zhījiān yīn wénhuà chāyì chǎnshēng de wèntí, zuì hǎo de bànfǎ jiùshì hùxiāng zūnzhòng.
examples.english: To solve problems that arise between races due to cultural differences, the best approach is mutual respect.

items.wordHook: a 䒑(grass top) pokes through 土(earth) beside a 工(work) bench → a tiny 差(difference).

examples.chinese: 那輛腳踏車對個子小的我來說太高了，腳很難跨過去。我們大學前年起已開放跨校選課，增加各校的交流機會。
examples.pinyin: Nà liàng jiǎotàchē duì gèzi xiǎo de wǒ lái shuō tài gāo le, jiǎo hěn nán kuà guòqù. Wǒmen dàxué qiánnián qǐ yǐ kāifàng kuàxiào xuǎnkè, zēngjiā gè xiào de jiāoliú jīhuì.
examples.english: That bicycle is too high for me, since I'm short, so it's hard to straddle my leg over it. Our university has offered cross-school course selection since the year before last, increasing opportunities for exchange between schools.

examples.chinese: 隔壁的王媽媽化妝以後，變年輕了。
examples.pinyin: Gébì de Wáng māma huàzhuāng yǐhòu, biàn niánqīng le.
examples.english: After putting on makeup, Mrs. Wang next door became younger.

examples.chinese: 雲小姐最近突然開始化妝了，人也變美了。大家都猜她戀愛了。
examples.pinyin: Yún xiǎojiě zuìjìn tūrán kāishǐ huàzhuāng le, rén yě biàn měi le. Dàjiā dōu cāi tā liàn'ài le.
examples.english: Miss Yun recently suddenly started wearing makeup, and she has become prettier too. Everyone guesses that she is in love.

examples.chinese: 有人說，男人的話題常跟政治有關，女人的話題不是名牌包、就是化妝品。你同意嗎？
examples.pinyin: Yǒu rén shuō, nánrén de huàtí cháng gēn zhèngzhì yǒuguān, nǚrén de huàtí bùshì míngpái bāo, jiùshì huàzhuāngpǐn. Nǐ tóngyì ma?
examples.english: Some people say that men's topics are often related to politics, and women's topics are either designer bags or cosmetics. Do you agree?

examples.chinese: 妳去面試時稍微化妝一下，是一種禮貌。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ qù miànshì shí shāowēi huàzhuāng yíxià, shì yì zhǒng lǐmào.
examples.english: When you go for an interview, putting on a little makeup is a kind of courtesy.

examples.chinese: 她愛好化妝、穿名牌服裝，目的是希望別人讚美她。
examples.pinyin: Tā àihào huàzhuāng, chuān míngpái fúzhuāng, mùdì shì xīwàng biérén zànměi tā.
examples.english: She loves makeup and wearing name-brand clothes; her purpose is to hope others praise her.

examples.chinese: 對夏天一活動汗就流個不停的女性來說，化妝實在是件麻煩事。
examples.pinyin: Duì xiàtiān yī huódòng hàn jiù liú ge bùtíng de nǚxìng lái shuō, huàzhuāng shízài shì jiàn máfan shì.
examples.english: For women who sweat nonstop as soon as they move in summer, putting on makeup is really a troublesome thing.

examples.chinese: 客人都抵達婚禮現場了，新娘卻還沒開始化妝，太誇張了！
examples.pinyin: Kèrén dōu dǐdá hūnlǐ xiànchǎng le, xīnniáng què hái méi kāishǐ huàzhuāng, tài kuāzhāng le!
examples.english: The guests have all arrived at the wedding venue, but the bride hasn't even started putting on makeup yet—that's too outrageous!

examples.chinese: 這種化妝品是針對東方人的皮膚設計的，在臺灣賣得很好。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zhǒng huàzhuāngpǐn shì zhēnduì dōngfāngrén de pífū shèjì de, zài Táiwān mài de hěn hǎo.
examples.english: This kind of cosmetics is designed specifically for Eastern people's skin, and sells very well in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我得在家做一份報告，不能出去玩。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge zhōumò wǒ děi zài jiā zuò yī fèn bàogào, bù néng chūqù wán.
examples.english: This weekend I have to stay home and write a report; I can't go out and have fun.

examples.chinese: 上中文課時，老師要我們用中文報告在台灣的生活。
examples.pinyin: Shàng Zhōngwén kè shí, lǎoshī yào wǒmen yòng Zhōngwén bàogào zài Táiwān de shēnghuó.
examples.english: In Chinese class, the teacher wants us to report in Chinese on our life in Taiwan.

examples.chinese: 我是陳老闆的助理，每天得向他報告公司的情況。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shì Chén lǎobǎn de zhùlǐ, měitiān děi xiàng tā bàogào gōngsī de qíngkuàng.
examples.english: I am Boss Chen's assistant; every day I have to report the company's situation to him.

examples.chinese: 為了做這個報告，經理已經跟我們開過三次會了。
examples.pinyin: Wèile zuò zhège bàogào, jīnglǐ yǐjīng gēn wǒmen kāi guò sān cì huì le.
examples.english: In order to prepare this report, the manager has already had meetings with us three times.

examples.chinese: 老師的要求很多，要寫五篇報告、三篇作文，怎麼寫得完？
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī de yāoqiú hěn duō, yào xiě wǔ piān bàogào, sān piān zuòwén, zěnme xiě de wán?
examples.english: The teacher's requirements are many: write five reports and three essays—how can one finish writing them?

examples.chinese: 等我完成期末報告，就要跟同學去韓國旅遊。
examples.pinyin: Děng wǒ wánchéng qīmò bàogào, jiù yào gēn tóngxué qù Hánguó lǚyóu.
examples.english: After I finish my final report, I will go traveling to Korea with my classmates.

examples.chinese: 那位教授看報告看得很仔細，你可不能亂寫。
examples.pinyin: Nà wèi jiàoshòu kàn bàogào kàn de hěn zǐxì, nǐ kě bù néng luàn xiě.
examples.english: That professor reads reports very carefully; you must not write carelessly.

examples.chinese: A:你怎麼了？昨天晚上沒睡好嗎？ B:嗯。要不是開夜車趕報告， 現在也不會這麼沒精神。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ zěnme le? Zuótiān wǎnshang méi shuì hǎo ma? B: Ńg. Yàobùshì kāi yèchē gǎn bàogào, xiànzài yě bù huì zhème méi jīngshén.
examples.english: A: What's wrong with you? Didn't you sleep well last night? B: Mm. If I hadn't stayed up late driving to finish my report, I wouldn't be so low on energy now.

examples.chinese: 新聞報告說颱風快來了，出門時得注意安全。
examples.pinyin: Xīnwén bàogào shuō táifēng kuài lái le, chūmén shí děi zhùyì ānquán.
examples.english: The news report says a typhoon is coming soon; when going out, you must pay attention to safety.

examples.chinese: 這個週末我過得很充實，不但完成了期末報告，還跟同學去游泳、衝浪。
examples.pinyin: Zhège zhōumò wǒ guò de hěn chōngshí, búdàn wánchéng le qīmò bàogào, hái gēn tóngxué qù yóuyǒng, chōnglàng.
examples.english: This weekend I had a very full time—not only did I finish my final report, but I also went swimming and surfing with classmates.

examples.chinese: 有一份研究報告表示，對陌生環境適應能力越強的人，未來成功的機會也越高。
examples.pinyin: Yǒu yī fèn yánjiū bàogào biǎoshì, duì mòshēng huánjìng shìyìng nénglì yuè qiáng de rén, wèilái chénggōng de jīhuì yě yuè gāo.
examples.english: A research report indicates that the stronger a person's ability to adapt to unfamiliar environments, the higher their chances of success in the future.

examples.chinese: 有關這場火災的詳細情況，等調查結果出來以後，市長會向民眾報告。
examples.pinyin: Yǒuguān zhè chǎng huǒzāi de xiángxì qíngkuàng, děng diàochá jiéguǒ chūlái yǐhòu, shìzhǎng huì xiàng mínzhòng bàogào.
examples.english: Regarding the detailed situation of this fire, after the investigation results come out, the mayor will report to the public.

examples.chinese: 我沒趕上最後一班公車，這下子只好搭計程車回家了。A:糟了，我不小心把隨身碟弄丟了，資料都存在裡面。 B:這下子我們的期末報告都白做了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ méi gǎnshàng zuìhòu yī bān gōngchē, zhè xiàzi zhǐhǎo dā jìchéngchē huí jiā le. A: Zāo le, wǒ bù xiǎoxīn bǎ suíshēndié nòng diū le, zīliào dōu cún zài lǐmiàn. B: Zhè xiàzi wǒmen de qīmò bàogào dōu bái zuò le.
examples.english: I didn't catch the last bus; now I have no choice but to take a taxi home. A: Oh no, I accidentally lost my USB drive; all the data is stored in it. B: Now all our final report work has been done in vain.

examples.chinese: 我的歷史作業寫完了，同時也把明天要報告的古蹟資料準備好了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de lìshǐ zuòyè xiě wán le, tóngshí yě bǎ míngtiān yào bàogào de gǔjì zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo le.
examples.english: I finished my history homework, and at the same time I also prepared the information on historical sites for tomorrow's report.

examples.chinese: 你寄報告給老師前最好確認一下地址，萬一老師沒收到，到時你就麻煩了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐ jì bàogào gěi lǎoshī qián zuìhǎo quèrèn yīxià dìzhǐ, wànyī lǎoshī méi shōudào, dào shí nǐ jiù máfan le.
examples.english: Before you mail the report to the teacher, you'd better confirm the address; if the teacher doesn't receive it, you'll be in trouble when the moment comes.

examples.chinese: 上臺報告以前要把資料準備好，以免到時候手忙腳亂的。
examples.pinyin: Shàngtái bàogào yǐqián yào bǎ zīliào zhǔnbèi hǎo, yǐmiǎn dào shíhou shǒumángjiǎoluàn de.
examples.english: Before going on stage to give a report, you need to prepare your materials well, so that you won't be in a rush and confused when the time comes.

examples.chinese: 老師不滿意我們這一組的報告，要我們重做一次。
examples.pinyin: Lǎoshī bù mǎnyì wǒmen zhè yì zǔ de bàogào, yào wǒmen chóng zuò yí cì.
examples.english: The teacher is not satisfied with our group's report and wants us to do it again.

examples.chinese: 昨天電視臺的氣象報告說今天會下雨，果然一大早就下起雨來了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān diànshìtái de qìxiàng bàogào shuō jīntiān huì xiàyǔ, guǒrán yí dàzǎo jiù xià qǐ yǔ lái le.
examples.english: Yesterday the TV station's weather report said it would rain today, and just as expected, it started raining early in the morning.

examples.chinese: 小王的閱讀報告寫得很精彩，連教授都在課堂上當面誇獎他。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Wáng de yuèdú bàogào xiě de hěn jīngcǎi, lián jiàoshòu dōu zài kètáng shàng dāngmiàn kuājiǎng tā.
examples.english: Xiao Wang's reading report was written wonderfully; even the professor praised him to his face in class.

examples.chinese: 每年春節時，爸爸都會送隔壁鄰居一盒蘋果，祝他們每天都平安、如意。
examples.pinyin: Měi nián chūnjié shí, bàba dōu huì sòng gébì línjū yī hé píngguǒ, zhù tāmen měi tiān dōu píng'ān, rúyì.
examples.english: Every year during Spring Festival, Dad gives the neighbor next door a box of apples, wishing them peace and that everything goes as they wish every day.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 再過幾天就要過年了，在此願大家新年平安，事事如意。
examples.pinyin: Zài guò jǐ tiān jiù yào guònián le, zài cǐ yuàn dàjiā xīnnián píng'ān, shìshì rúyì.
examples.english: In a few days it will be Chinese New Year; here I wish everyone a peaceful new year and that everything goes as you wish.

items.wordHook: Combining 如(if) and 意(thought): 如意 means as you wish.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 我們的足球教練認為，比賽前跑步是必要的訓練，從明天起每天得跑一個小時。
examples.pinyin: Wǒmen de zúqiú jiàoliàn rènwéi, bǐsài qián pǎobù shì bìyào de xùnliàn, cóng míngtiān qǐ měitiān děi pǎo yī ge xiǎoshí.
examples.english: Our soccer coach believes that running before a game is necessary training; starting tomorrow, we have to run for an hour every day.

examples.chinese: 雖然小馬的個子不高，不過籃球打得可好了。
examples.pinyin: Suīrán Xiǎo Mǎ de gèzi bù gāo, bùguò lánqiú dǎ de kě hǎo le.
examples.english: Although Xiao Ma's build is not tall, he plays basketball really well.

examples.chinese: 這雙球鞋的設計很特別，在百貨公司的專櫃才買得到。
examples.pinyin: Zhè shuāng qiúxié de shèjì hěn tèbié, zài bǎihuò gōngsī de zhuānguì cái mǎi de dào.
examples.english: The design of this pair of sneakers is very special; you can only buy them at the brand counter in a department store.

examples.chinese: 像踢足球那樣的運動，對年紀大的人不太合適。
examples.pinyin: Xiàng tī zúqiú nàyàng de yùndòng, duì niánjì dà de rén bù tài héshì.
examples.english: Sports like playing soccer are not very suitable for older people.

examples.chinese: 對我來說，冬天的樂趣就是戴著厚厚的手套，和朋友玩雪球。
examples.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, dōngtiān de lèqù jiùshì dài zhe hòu hòu de shǒutào, hé péngyǒu wán xuěqiú.
examples.english: For me, the joy of winter is wearing thick gloves and playing snowballs with friends.

examples.chinese: 小安現在的健康情況很差，就算很想參加網球比賽，恐怕也贏不了。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo'ān xiànzài de jiànkāng qíngkuàng hěn chà, jiùsuàn hěn xiǎng cānjiā wǎngqiú bǐsài, kǒngpà yě yíng bùliǎo.
examples.english: Xiao'an's current health condition is very poor. Even if he really wants to participate in the tennis match, I'm afraid he won't be able to win.

examples.chinese: 我只參加過籃球比賽，其他運動比賽我都沒有經驗。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zhǐ cānjiāguo lánqiú bǐsài, qítā yùndòng bǐsài wǒ dōu méiyǒu jīngyàn.
examples.english: I have only participated in basketball competitions; I have no experience in other sports competitions.

examples.chinese: 我記得去年跟幾個朋友一起打過籃球，真好玩。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jìde qùnián gēn jǐ gè péngyǒu yīqǐ dǎguo lánqiú, zhēn hǎowán.
examples.english: I remember last year I played basketball with a few friends; it was really fun.

examples.chinese: 他因為打籃球的時候不小心，所以手受傷了。
examples.pinyin: Tā yīnwèi dǎ lánqiú de shíhòu bù xiǎoxīn, suǒyǐ shǒu shòushāng le.
examples.english: Because he was not careful when playing basketball, his hand got injured.

examples.chinese: 我覺得打球比跑步有意思，我常跟朋友一起打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ juéde dǎqiú bǐ pǎobù yǒu yìsi, wǒ cháng gēn péngyǒu yìqǐ dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I think playing ball is more interesting than running; I often play basketball with friends.

examples.chinese: 我身體不舒服，所以不能跟你們去打球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ shēntǐ bù shūfu, suǒyǐ bù néng gēn nǐmen qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: I am not feeling well, so I cannot go play ball with you.

examples.chinese: 如果明天天氣好，我就去打球。
examples.pinyin: Rúguǒ míngtiān tiānqì hǎo, wǒ jiù qù dǎ qiú.
examples.english: If the weather is good tomorrow, then I will go play ball.

examples.chinese: 今天下午學校有籃球比賽，我們去看吧！
examples.pinyin: Jīntiān xiàwǔ xuéxiào yǒu lánqiú bǐsài, wǒmen qù kàn ba!
examples.english: There is a basketball game at school this afternoon. Let’s go watch it!

examples.chinese: 我的興趣是運動，打網球、游泳，我都喜歡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ de xìngqù shì yùndòng, dǎ wǎngqiú, yóuyǒng, wǒ dōu xǐhuān.
examples.english: My hobby is doing exercise. I like both tennis and swimming.

examples.chinese: 那個孩子很愛踢足球。
examples.pinyin: Nà ge háizi hěn ài tī zúqiú.
examples.english: That kid loves to play soccer very much.

examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜歡打棒球，我想送他一個棒球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ dìdi xǐhuān dǎ bàngqiú, wǒ xiǎng sòng tā yí ge bàngqiú.
examples.english: My younger brother likes playing baseball, I’d like to give him a baseball as a gift.

examples.chinese: 我每個週末去學校打籃球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge zhōumò qù xuéxiào dǎ lánqiú.
examples.english: I go to school to play basketball every weekend.

examples.chinese: 我跟同學常常一起在學校打網球。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tóngxué chángcháng yìqǐ zài xuéxiào dǎ wǎngqiú.
examples.english: My classmates and I often play tennis together at the school.

examples.chinese: 打網球怎麼樣？中明說妳的網球打得很好，我們一起去打吧。
examples.pinyin: Dǎ wǎngqiú zěnmeyàng? Zhōngmíng shuō nǐ de wǎngqiú dǎ de hěn hǎo, wǒmen yìqǐ qù dǎ ba.
examples.english: How about playing tennis? Zhongming said you play it well. Let’s go play it together.

examples.chinese: 參加籃球社的條件是跑步的速度得夠快，但是沒有身高的限制。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā lánqiú shè de tiáojiàn shì pǎobù de sùdù děi gòu kuài, dànshì méiyǒu shēngāo de xiànzhì.
examples.english: The condition for joining the basketball club is that your running speed must be fast enough, but there is no height restriction.

examples.chinese: 黃先生的腳因為車禍受了很嚴重的傷，醫生建議他不要做太激烈的運動。這場網球比賽打得很激烈，已經打了五個小時了，還不知道誰輸誰贏。
examples.pinyin: Huáng xiānsheng de jiǎo yīnwèi chēhuò shòule hěn yánzhòng de shāng, yīshēng jiànyì tā búyào zuò tài jīliè de yùndòng. Zhè chǎng wǎngqiú bǐsài dǎ de hěn jīliè, yǐjīng dǎle wǔ ge xiǎoshí le, hái bù zhīdào shéi shū shéi yíng.
examples.english: Mr. Huang's foot was seriously injured in a car accident; the doctor advised him not to do overly intense exercise. This tennis match is being played very fiercely; it has already been played for five hours, and it is still unknown who will lose and who will win.

examples.chinese: 小時候爺爺常陪我做功課、教我打球和釣魚，現在回想起那段時間，感覺真幸福。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎoshíhou yéye cháng péi wǒ zuò gōngkè, jiāo wǒ dǎqiú hé diàoyú, xiànzài huíxiǎng qǐ nà duàn shíjiān, gǎnjué zhēn xìngfú.
examples.english: When I was little, my grandfather often accompanied me to do homework and taught me to play ball and fish; now when I recall that time, I feel truly happy.

examples.chinese: 你們之間的誤會越來越深，要是不面對面說清楚，恐怕連朋友都當不成了。下課以後，老師幫我一對一補習數學，希望我的期末考會及格。昨天的歐洲足球賽，法國對義大利的比賽真是太刺激了。
examples.pinyin: Nǐmen zhījiān de wùhuì yuè lái yuè shēn, yàobùshì miànduìmiàn shuō qīngchǔ, kǒngpà lián péngyǒu dōu dāng bù chéng le. Xiàkè yǐhòu, lǎoshī bāng wǒ yī duì yī bǔxí shùxué, xīwàng wǒ de qīmòkǎo huì jígé. Zuótiān de Ōuzhōu zúqiúsài, Fǎguó duì Yìdàlì de bǐsài zhēn shì tài cìjī le.
examples.english: The misunderstanding between you two is getting deeper and deeper; if you don't talk it out face to face, I'm afraid you won't even be able to remain friends. After class, the teacher helped me with one-on-one math tutoring, hoping I will pass the final exam. Yesterday's European football match, France versus Italy, was really too exciting.

examples.chinese: 史教授為了讓更多人了解保護地球環境有多重要，經常到各地去演講。
examples.pinyin: Shǐ jiàoshòu wèi le ràng gèng duō rén liǎojiě bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng yǒu duō zhòngyào, jīngcháng dào gèdì qù yǎnjiǎng.
examples.english: In order to let more people understand how important it is to protect the Earth's environment, Professor Shi often goes to various places to give speeches.

examples.chinese: 只要打開手機，連上網路，就能立刻掌握全球新聞。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyào dǎkāi shǒujī, liánshàng wǎnglù, jiù néng lìkè zhǎngwò quánqiú xīnwén.
examples.english: As long as you turn on your phone and connect to the internet, you can immediately grasp global news.

examples.chinese: 昨天棒球賽進行到一半時突然下起了大雨，雖然後來雨停了，但因為球場太溼，也無法繼續比賽了。
examples.pinyin: Zuótiān bàngqiúsài jìnxíng dào yíbàn shí tūrán xià qǐ le dàyǔ, suīrán hòulái yǔ tíng le, dàn yīnwèi qiúchǎng tài shī, yě wúfǎ jìxù bǐsài le.
examples.english: Yesterday, when the baseball game had proceeded to halfway, it suddenly started raining heavily. Although the rain stopped later, because the field was too wet, the game could not continue.

examples.chinese: 科學家發明了電燈，改變了人類的生活方式，也大大提高了生活品質。網路是很偉大的發明，就算不出門，也能讓人們得到全球各地的訊息。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā fāmíng le diàndēng, gǎibiàn le rénlèi de shēnghuó fāngshì, yě dàdà tígāo le shēnghuó pǐnzhí. Wǎnglù shì hěn wěidà de fāmíng, jiùsuàn bù chūmén, yě néng ràng rénmen dédào quánqiú gèdì de xùnxí.
examples.english: Scientists invented the electric light, which changed the lifestyle of mankind and also greatly improved the quality of life. The Internet is a great invention; even without going out, it can let people get information from all over the world.

examples.chinese: 使用地球資源和保護地球環境是相對的，資源使用得越多，環境就越需要被保護。
examples.pinyin: Shǐyòng dìqiú zīyuán hé bǎohù dìqiú huánjìng shì xiāngduì de, zīyuán shǐyòng de yuè duō, huánjìng jiù yuè xūyào bèi bǎohù.
examples.english: Using Earth's resources and protecting Earth's environment are relative: the more resources are used, the more the environment needs to be protected.

items.wordHook: a 王(jade) bead takes the 求(seek) of eager hands → the 球(ball).

examples.chinese: 學生：明天就要大學考試了，我很緊張，怕考不好。 老師：你是很優秀的學生，我相信只要盡自己的能力，好好發揮實力，一定沒問題的。
examples.pinyin: Xuéshēng: Míngtiān jiù yào dàxué kǎoshì le, wǒ hěn jǐnzhāng, pà kǎo bù hǎo. Lǎoshī: Nǐ shì hěn yōuxiù de xuéshēng, wǒ xiāngxìn zhǐyào jìn zìjǐ de nénglì, hǎohǎo fāhuī shílì, yīdìng méi wèntí de.
examples.english: Student: The university exam is tomorrow; I'm very nervous and afraid I won't do well. Teacher: You are an excellent student; I believe that as long as you do your best according to your ability and fully demonstrate your strength, there will definitely be no problem.

examples.chinese: 做好環境保護的工作，是每個現代人應盡的責任。
examples.pinyin: Zuò hǎo huánjìng bǎohù de gōngzuò, shì měi ge xiàndài rén yīng jìn de zérèn.
examples.english: Doing a good job in environmental protection is the responsibility that every modern person should fulfill.

examples.chinese: 照顧還沒成年的孩子是父母應盡的責任，無論如何，既然生了就該養他、教導他。
examples.pinyin: Zhàogù hái méi chéngnián de háizi shì fùmǔ yīng jìn de zérèn, wúlùnrúhé, jìrán shēng le jiù gāi yǎng tā, jiàodǎo tā.
examples.english: Taking care of children who are not yet adults is a responsibility parents should fulfill; in any case, since you gave birth to them, you should raise them and educate them.

examples.chinese: 他告訴孩子不需要事事追求第一，但做任何事都必須盡力。
examples.pinyin: Tā gàosù háizi bù xūyào shìshì zhuīqiú dì yī, dàn zuò rènhé shì dōu bìxū jìnlì.
examples.english: He told his children that they don't need to pursue first place in everything, but they must strive their hardest in whatever they do.

items.wordHook: Using a brush 聿(brush) over bright 灬(fire) to scrape every remnant from the 皿(dish) goes to the 盡(greatest extent).

examples.chinese: 這個世界拼圖很難拼，得花好幾天才拼得成。
examples.pinyin: Zhè ge shìjiè pīntú hěn nán pīn, děi huā hǎo jǐ tiān cái pīn de chéng.
examples.english: This world puzzle is very difficult to piece together; it will take several days to piece it together successfully.

examples.chinese: 他是華僑，說中文時常帶點兒當地的口音。
examples.pinyin: Tā shì huáqiáo, shuō Zhōngwén shí cháng dài diǎnr dāngdì de kǒuyīn.
examples.english: He is an overseas Chinese; when he speaks Chinese, he often has a bit of a local accent.

items.wordHook: Repeating 叔(uncle) twice for emphasis: 叔叔 means uncle.
奶(milk) + 茶(tea) → 奶茶(milk tea).
Repeating 年(year) twice for emphasis: 年年 means every year.
Unfurl the fishing 罒(net) in a 直(straight) line along the beach to 置(lay out).
Making skills 適(match) what one 應(should) handle: 適應 means adapt to.
